# Ritunia

> One-of-a-kind gothic art dolls and miniature sculptures — sculpted, painted, and
> finished entirely by hand by a single maker. Ritunia is a museum-style showcase,
> not a shop: each piece is documented like a museum specimen, with material,
> dimensions, year, and provenance.

## Pages

- [Home](https://ritunia.com/): Overview of the collection and the maker.
- [Archive](https://ritunia.com/figurines): Full registry of gothic handmade miniatures, filterable by status, year, and series.
- [About the Master](https://ritunia.com/author): Biography and background of the artist behind Ritunia.
- [Workshop](https://ritunia.com/workshop): Process, materials, and technique notes.
- [Commission](https://ritunia.com/commission): How to commission a new one-of-a-kind piece.

## Notes

- Every figurine has its own permanent page at /figurines/{slug} with a description, material, dimensions, year, and photography.
- Pieces are not sold off-the-shelf; acquisition is by commission or reservation, as described on each figurine's page.
- Full machine-readable list of figurine pages: https://ritunia.com/sitemap.xml
